Bug_Title: Equals method should be overridden in records containing array fields
Bug_Explanation: The Person record class has an array field (names) and is not overriding the equals() method, which means it is using the default implementation of Object.equals() which compares array fields by their reference rather than their content.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by comparing two Person objects (person1 and person2) using the equals() method in the Person.showBug() method. Since the equals() method is not overridden in the Person record class, the default implementation of equals() is used, which compares array fields by reference. In this case, the names array fields of person1 and person2 are different objects, even though they contain the same elements. Therefore, the equals() method returns false, and the assertFalse() assertion fails, triggering the bug.
